To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
compliant fingers and soft skin allow for a high contact area and contact forces.
compliant hands can be used to perform complex tasks, and soft electronic skins can be used to measure the forces exerted by compliant fingers on objects.
the integration of compliance and tactile sensing into robotic hands can be achieved through the use of soft and compliant materials.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and implementation of soft bionics hands with an integrated sense of touch for applications in prosthetics, rehabilitation, and industrial robotics.
the development of a compliant, under-actuated, multi-fingered hand with a sense of touch.
the design of compliant robotic hands with an electronic skin for the integration of soft sensors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the integration of compliant materials into the design of underactuated hands has the potential to improve the functionality of such hands for both industrial and rehabilitation applications.
the soft bionic hands with a sense of touch are a good alternative to the existing prosthetic hands.
the design of compliant fingers with soft and compliant skin is an effective approach for the development of under-actuation hands with a sense of touch.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated that soft bionics hands can have a sense of touch.
we developed a soft and compliant hand with a sense of touch that could potentially be used as a prosthesis.
the soft bionic hands are a promising alternative to the conventional rigid hands, especially in applications where a sense of touch is required.
The main takeaway from our work is that
compliant hands are not just a simple alternative to rigid ones, but they are a different approach with their own set of advantages.
soft and compliant hands are more efficient than rigid hands, and the addition of a soft and compliant skin enhances the functionality and performance of these hands.
the combination of compliance and sensing in the fingers of robotic hands is an effective strategy that can be used to develop hands for prosthetic and industrial applications.
